summary: Explicit candidate-alignment workflow that inventories CLI/Claude/Codex and transactionally updates packaged, uv-tool, or source components with durable recovery.

entry_points.summary: Thin host wrapper; delegates lifecycle decisions to the CLI.
Recover retained state, fetch manifest, inventory components, and dispatch.
Classify CLI, Claude, and Codex independently without masking missing hosts.
Choose one coherent candidate-alignment path for all stale components.
Hand packaged hosts and optional verified uv wheel to install.sh.
Back up, upgrade, verify, and recover the confined uv tool and launchers.
Fetch exact candidate tag and fast-forward one clean checkout recoverably.
Restore mutated components in reverse order from durable pre-state.
Recover an interrupted installer transaction before new mutation.
Validate, journal, mutate, verify candidate coherence, and commit.
Fetch latest.json and enforce manifest schema, URL, and digest syntax.
Classify tagged, newer, stale, or development install versions.
Build and audit the deterministic tarball from one canonical stage.
Emit observational checkout telemetry, never release identity.

invariants: Every invocation recovers retained lifecycle state under exclusive ownership before fetching a new manifest.
CLI, Claude, and Codex are inventoried independently; missing hosts are never added by update.
All selected stale components must align to one explicit manifest candidate or no mutation commits.
Packaged Claude/Codex payloads self-update through verified tarball metadata and install.sh's durable transaction.
A stale uv CLI may join the packaged-host transaction through a token-bound lock handoff; standalone uv replacement has durable tool/launcher backup.
Source updates require one clean HOME-confined checkout, the exact candidate tag and VERSION, ancestry, and git merge --ff-only.
Mixed source and packaged hosts, different source roots, downgrade pressure, or stale unsupported CLI modes fail before mutation.
Installer rollback reverses payload, marketplace, registration, export, CLI, and launcher mutations from durable pre-state; incomplete recovery remains fail-closed.
Manifest URLs require HTTPS and SHA-256 fields require 64 hex characters; downloaded wheel and remote tarball bytes are verified before mutation.
Development/non-release versions are notices only; no automatic update is applied.
scripts/version.sh reports checkout telemetry only and cannot supply release candidate identity.
MCP z_update is read-only; only explicit z-harness update or /z-update mutates lifecycle state.
gotchas: The host skill is only a wrapper; component inventory, locking, recovery, and candidate decisions belong to update.py/release.py/install.sh.
Packaged update replaces only already-detected Claude/Codex hosts; it does not install a missing host.
Mixed symlink and packaged payloads or symlinks backed by different checkouts cannot be updated atomically and are rejected.
Source checkout and recovery paths must remain beneath HOME; uv tool/launcher recovery is confined to supported HOME locations.
Source updates do not refresh a versioned Claude cache or re-run Codex registration; restart hosts after success.
Packaged Codex transactions update the marketplace and verify registration when codex is available; uncertain compensation retains state and blocks mutation.
A live lifecycle owner blocks concurrent update/install; stale locks are reclaimed using PID plus process-start identity.
The fallback _apply_reinstall_hint remains for unknown/non-uv states, but it is not the packaged Claude/Codex update path.
